_note: Per-load-zone map centroids for GET /og/api/fleet/map. A hub whose og.hub.lat/lon is NULL is drawn at a deterministic point inside its zone's disc (centroid + radius_km, jittered by a hash of hub_id). As soon as og.hub carries real coordinates the API uses them instead, with no change here. The four ERCOT load zones use the load-weighted mean of their mapped weather zones in grid_map_data.json (forecast.service.DEFAULT_WEATHER_ZONES_BY_LOAD_ZONE); the regulated-utility zones use the utility's main city. These are display positions, not asset locations.
